# customers
---

<!-- Generated by docs/5-reference/generate.py from the doc comments: do not edit. -->

Package customers is the people the artist draws for and sells to, and the social networks she reaches them on. The networks are a list she edits: each has a link pattern that turns a handle into the address of the profile.

| Name | What it is |
|---|---|
| `const UserMark = "{user}"` | UserMark is where a network's link pattern takes the handle: "https://x.com/{user}". |
| `func ProblemWords(code Code) string` | ProblemWords is what the artist reads about a problem, in Spanish; the code when it has no words. |
| `type Code string` | Code is a stable name for what went wrong, for programs to check and people to search for. |
| `const CodeBlankName Code = "customers.blank-name" ...` | Error codes of this package. |
| `type Customer struct{ ... }` | Customer is someone the artist works for: a name, a way to reach them and their profiles. |
| `type Error struct{ ... }` | Error is a failure of the customers: its code, what it was doing and what lay underneath. |
| `type Network struct{ ... }` | Network is a social network the artist reaches customers on. |
| `type Profile struct{ ... }` | Profile is a customer's handle on one network. |
| `type Store struct{ ... }` | Store keeps customers and networks in the database. |
| `func NewStore(database *storage.Database, now func() time.Time, newID func() string) *Store` | NewStore keeps customers in database; tests pass a fixed clock and fixed ids. |
